Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://rollx-docs.gitbook.io/rollx/what-is-rollx.md). # ❓What is RollX? Launched in 2024 by a global team, RollX is a perpetual trading platform built on Base that enables users to trade BTC and leading assets with up to 1000× leverage. It supports multi-asset and BTC-native collateral, combining CEX-level performance with full on-chain transparency. RollX is community-owned, returning trading fees to stakers and liquidity providers through a sustainable, reward-driven ecosystem. RollX V1 employs a fully on-chain liquidity model, offering transparent perpetual trading with minimal slippage. Trades execute directly against the RLP pool (supporting USDT/USDC/BTC/cbBTC and more), optimizing capital efficiency across all trading pairs. Prices are aggregated from multiple exchanges, reducing liquidation risks from temporary market wicks. Classic Mode: Trade universal assets with up to 100x leverage. Pro Mode: Trade universal assets with up to 500x leverage.

# ⛲️ RLP Pool

RLP, the liquidity provider token of RollX, is backed by a pool of assets. Users have the opportunity to participate as liquidity providers by acquiring RLP using specified assets. The RLP pool serves as a direct counterparty to on-chain perpetual traders on V1.

RLP Pool:

Initially priced at USD$1, the value of RLP is influenced by the performance of the pool, including profits or losses, as well as income generated from trading fees, funding fees, and liquidations. Users who mint RLP benefit from platform fees, which contribute to the net asset value of RLP. Additionally, users can stake RLP to earn rewards points. Stay tuned for further updates!

Note: Following the purchase of RLP, users are unable to transfer it to other wallet addresses. Presently, only selling, staking, and redeem functions are supported.

How to purchase RLP? Step 1: Access the RollX Pools Dashboard page and connect your wallet by clicking on the designated button. Step 2: Once your wallet is connected, proceed to click on the option labeled **\[Buy RLP]**. You have the flexibility to use any of the assets available in the RLP pool to acquire RLP tokens. Step 3: Review the provided information and confirm your purchase by clicking on the **\[Buy RLP]** button to finalize the transaction. Please note: Users are restricted from selling RLP during the initial 24-hour period following the purchase.

# 2. How to stake or redeem?

Step 1: Access the RollDex Pools Dashboard page and connect your wallet by clicking the designated button.

Step 2: Select the option **\[Stake/Redeem]**, enter the desired amount for staking or redeeming, and proceed by clicking **\[Confirm]**. Upon staking, you will commence earning staking rewards in the form of points. Monitor your accumulated rewards on the LP Dashboard.

RLP is a leveraged trading-counterparty liquidity share; PnL, oracle prices, dynamic balance-weighted fees and integer truncation affect mint/burn outcomes and LP value may become zero.

Mint funding is caller-owned and atomic. For wrapped-native 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006, TransferHelper requires msg.value; ordinary nonpayable mintLP cannot fund it, so use mintLPNative for native ETH, not mintLP(WETH).

minLp/minOut are user-supplied output floors in LP/token base units; no slippage or price guarantee. Mint resets caller cooling timestamp; admin-changeable cooling period, treasury/max-withdrawable liquidity and pause can block burns.

Burn destroys caller LP (prior allowance may be required) and pays selected receiver. Wrapped-native outputs become ETH only for EOA receivers; contract receivers get wrapped ERC20 under TransferHelper, even burnLPNative.
